features: 4K Ultra HD Video & 20MP Photo Capture: Record crisp 4K Ultra HD videos and capture detailed 20MP photos, suitable for travel, cycling, hiking, family vacations, outdoor adventures and everyday memories
Waterproof Housing for Underwater Adventures: Includes a waterproof protective casing designed for underwater use up to 30 metres, suitable for swimming, snorkeling, diving, surfing and water sports

170° Wide-Angle Lens with EIS Stabilization: Capture wider scenes with the 170° ultra-wide lens while Electronic Image Stabilization (EIS) helps reduce camera shake for smoother videos during cycling, biking, trekking and other action-packed activities
WiFi Connectivity & Remote Control: Connect your compatible smartphone for live preview, easy sharing and remote operation, allowing you to capture photos and videos from different angles

Complete Adventure Ready Kit: Includes versatile mounting accessories for helmets, bicycles, tripods and more, along with a rechargeable battery designed for extended recording sessions during outdoor adventures
Long-Lasting Rechargeable Battery: Extended battery life ensures you can film for hours without interruptions during your adventures and outdoor activities
Compact and Portable Design: Lightweight and compact construction allows for easy transport and convenient storage in backpacks, making it suitable for travel and on-the-go recording
Multiple Recording Modes: Features various shooting modes and settings to accommodate different scenarios including time-lapse, burst photo, and loop recording for versatile content creation
